## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`Persona`](../classes/gmeow-Persona.md) to name the context that activates it — a [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) or a situation type.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single context (it is non-functional — several activation contexts coexist) and avoid encoding blend-vs-compete dynamics here; that is solver work over recorded precedence ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:activatedIn`](gmeow-activatedIn.md) at a [`gmeow:Condition`](../classes/gmeow-Condition.md) (prose-canonical, evaluated only as ConditionEvaluations) or situation type; resolve simultaneous activations via [`gmeow:overrides`](gmeow-overrides.md) on the activation norms.
